The '''Uquine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] that contained the planet [[Uquine/Legends|Uquine]].

==History==
The system joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[10,966 BBY]], the [[Pius Dea]] [[Pius Dea|Faithful]] were decimated by the combined forces of the [[Renunciates]], [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], ending the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict]] and the [[Pius Dea Era]].<ref name="EGW" />
